ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with localized high-intensity (white) regions primarily on the left lobe and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, contiguous high-intensity white patch is located on the proximal-to-medial section of the left lobe. The right lobe and distal margins of both lobes exhibit a high frequency of discrete, small-scale white mottling and focal points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped median notch with an obtuse aperture angle and minimal vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; characterized by low-amplitude peaks interspersed with several deep, irregular indentations on the left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex trailing edge curve that terminates in narrow, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast white pixel clusters visible on the medial-to-distal regions of the right lobe and along the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch-like loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry, with the left lobe possessing a large solid white region compared to the predominantly dark and mottled right lobe.
